context: Mixing Charm v2 modules into an application still on v1

checklist.name: shared_types_rule
checklist.description: States that Bubble Tea, Bubbles, Huh, and Lip Gloss share types and move together: a Huh v2 form can run standalone with `Run` next to the v1 TUI, but embedding it in the v1 Bubble Tea program is impossible because Huh v2 is built on Bubble Tea v2 and Lip Gloss v2.

checklist.name: log_v2_standalone
checklist.description: Says Charm Log v2 can be added now, and that customizing its `Styles` needs Lip Gloss v2 values, not the app's v1 styles.

checklist.name: charm_land_paths
checklist.description: Uses `charm.land/huh/v2` and `charm.land/log/v2` in the `go get` command, not `github.com/charmbracelet/...` paths, which stop before v2.

checklist.name: pinned_versions
checklist.description: Pins explicit versions in the `go get` command (current releases: huh v2.0.3, log v2.0.1) instead of `@latest`.

checklist.name: coexistence_mechanics
checklist.description: Explains that v1 and v2 are separate modules that can coexist in one binary, and that passing a `Style` or model across the boundary is a compile error naming both paths.

checklist.name: github_paths_kept
checklist.description: Notes that `colorprofile` (and Harmonica) keep their `github.com/charmbracelet/...` paths; only the libraries above moved to `charm.land`.
